title: Enrollment Operations Rule: Auto-Assignment after the New-Member Choice Period (Primary Care Provider Assignment)
content:
**Primary Care Provider Assignment — auto-assignment of a new member who has not chosen a PCP.**

**Rule 1 — Who is auto-assigned and to whom.** A new member who has not chosen a PCP is auto-assigned to a practice type that can receive auto-assigned members, choosing first a provider the member saw within the practice type's claims look-back months, then the PCP of a household member, then the nearest open panel matching the member's age.

**Rule 2 — The choice period.** Auto-assignment happens only after the practice type's auto-assignment days have fully passed since the plan membership's enrollment date. The choice period is counted in calendar days from the day after the enrollment date, and auto-assignment may run only on a day strictly after the last day of the period. The enrollment date is the one on the system record of the plan membership; the comparison is made before the assignment is created.

**Rule 3 — One free change.** An auto-assigned member may change once for member preference without the change counting toward the limit when the change is requested within the practice type's auto-assignment days of the auto-assignment effective date.

| Practice type | Can receive auto-assigned members | Choice period and free-change period (calendar days) | Claims look-back for a prior PCP relationship (months) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Primary Care Provider | Yes | 30 | 24 |
| Pediatric Primary Care Provider | Yes | 30 | 24 |
| OB/GYN Primary Care Provider | No | 30 | 24 |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Home | Yes | 30 | 24 |
| Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice | Yes | 30 | 24 |
| Specialist Serving as PCP | No | 30 | 24 |
| Health Home Lead Provider | No | 30 | 24 |

**Choice period: boundary cases (hypothetical enrollment date 1 March)**

| Day | Position in the period | Auto-assignment may run |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March | The enrollment date itself; not counted | No |
| 2 March | Day 1 of the 30-day period | No |
| 31 March | Day 30, the last day of the period | No |
| 1 April | The first day strictly after the period | Yes |

**Order of choice (hypothetical member)**

| Found in the member's records | Provider chosen |
|---|---|
| A provider the member saw within the last 24 months | That provider |
| No such provider; a household member has a PCP | The household member's PCP |
| Neither | The nearest open panel matching the member's age |

In every row the practice type must be one that can receive auto-assigned members.
